candidates.reason: Mostly a scaled-up copy of the original: everything is packed into the top 60% and there is a ~200px dead band between the CTA and the footer; the badge is undersized for the square and floats high instead of centring on the text block; the CTA is oversized and competes with the headline.

Hierarchy and reading order are broken. The badge dominates, the headline is shrunk to a small single line, and the 'Subscribe & Save' eyebrow drops to the bottom below its own headline and footer. The CTA is tiny and pushed to the far right, footer text is near-illegible, and the right and bottom areas are left empty.

Headline and badge fill the square better than candidate 1, but the CTA pill is very wide and heavy enough to compete with the headline, the badge sits high and close to the right edge instead of centring on the text column, and a large empty band still separates the CTA from the footer.

Best rearrangement for the square: the text column is centred vertically, the larger badge is centred on the headline/CTA block, margins are consistent and the hierarchy is clear. It still needs polish: the gap between the CTA and the footer is a bit large, and the lower ~110px is somewhat empty.
